title: For every fixed c, s(k^2-c) = k for all large k, with an explicit constant (preprint)
description: Licences in this single record: the preprint (paper/paper.pdf, paper/paper.tex) is licensed under CC BY 4.0; the programs and data (code/, data/) under the MIT License, which is the licence shown for the record. Preprint with verification programs. For every fixed c, s(k^2-c) = k for all sufficiently large k, where s(n) is the side of the smallest square containing n non-overlapping unit squares. Explicitly: every packing of N unit squares in [0,k]^2 that are pairwise disjoint as closed sets has k^2 - N >= 0.033 log k for every integer k >= 2 (0.027 log k without the computer-assisted Lemma 4.10). Lemma 4.10 is a branch-and-bound computation re-verified in Arb ball arithmetic; its programs, data and logs are included. Version 1.1 adds two independent checks that the accepted boxes cover the parameter domain. Use of AI: developed with extensive assistance from Claude (Anthropic), including the proofs, the text, the programs and the computation for Lemma 4.10; the author takes full responsibility. Not peer reviewed.
